proposal.reason: Main change is review-routing policy/automation behavior: .github/scripts/review_automation.py adds run-number staleness protection before saving/inviting, adjusts required-reviewer lifecycle, and handles 422 withdrawal as warning with explicit gate guidance. Supporting workflow plumbing in .github/workflows/review-gate.yml, review-squash-preview.yml, review-routing.yml plus maintainer_approval.py/commit_message_squash.py normalizes PR-number identification and concurrency groups for the same review/squash pipelines. .github/skills/pccl-review-assignment/modules.json and .github/WORKFLOWS.md update module-classification and reviewer-policy documentation. These are all owned by contribution/review workflow policy and wiring, not runtime PCCL modules.
